notes: The Link accounts to IGG window is redesigned: it fills the screen and does not scroll, long forms (logins, mailbox, emails, passwords) open in their own windows from a button, and the status tables turn pages with Previous and Next. The IGG record (the Excel file and its working files) now lives in its own folder, config\IGG logins, and is moved there automatically. Every screen except Fleet now fills the window, so the Health log, Rally, Turf, Supply, Leader and Relay no longer leave a blank band under the status bar.
